disclaimer: General skincare guidance. Not medical advice. Review with a dermatologist before public distribution.

AM.title: Salicylic Acid / Gentle Gel Cleanser
howToApply: Dispense a coin-size amount into wet palms
Lather and gently massage over face for 30-60 seconds
Rinse thoroughly with lukewarm water and pat dry with a clean towel
AM.whyItHelps: Unclogs pores, removes excess sebum accumulated overnight, and prevents morning shine.
AM.avoidNotes: Avoid harsh scrubbing or hot water which triggers rebound oil production.

AM.title: Pore-Refining Balancing Toner
howToApply: Pour 3-4 drops directly onto clean palms or a cotton pad
Gently press into face and neck until absorbed
Do not rub aggressively
AM.whyItHelps: Balances skin pH after cleansing and regulates sebum production.
AM.avoidNotes: Avoid alcohol-based toners that sting or dry out skin.

AM.title: Niacinamide & Zinc Serum
howToApply: Apply 2-3 drops to slightly damp skin
Spread evenly across T-zone and cheeks
Allow 1 minute to absorb before moisturizer
AM.whyItHelps: Minimizes pore appearance, reduces excess oil, and strengthens barrier.
AM.avoidNotes: If using Vitamin C, separate to alternating mornings.

AM.title: Oil-Free Hydrating Gel Moisturizer
howToApply: Dot a pea-sized amount on forehead, cheeks, nose, and chin
Smooth outward in upward circular motions
Don't forget your neck
AM.whyItHelps: Provides non-greasy hydration so skin doesn't overproduce oil.
AM.avoidNotes: Avoid heavy comedogenic oils (coconut oil, mineral oil).

AM.title: Matte Finish Fluid Sunscreen SPF 50
howToApply: Apply 2 full finger-lengths (approx. 1/4 teaspoon) to face and neck
Apply 15 minutes before sun exposure
Reapply every 2 hours if outdoors or after sweating
AM.whyItHelps: Protects against UV damage, dark spot darkening, and premature aging without clogging pores.
AM.avoidNotes: Do not skip sunscreen even on cloudy or indoor days.

PM.title: Double Cleanse: Clarifying Cleanser
PM.texture: Gel or micellar water followed by gel cleanser
howToApply: If wearing sunscreen or makeup, use micellar water or oil cleanser first
Follow with gel cleanser for 60 seconds with lukewarm water
Pat dry with a soft clean towel
PM.whyItHelps: Removes SPF, pollution, sunscreen residue, and deep-seated grime.

PM.title: Exfoliating BHA Toner (2-3x / week)
howToApply: Saturate a cotton pad and sweep across oily areas
Focus on T-zone and chin
Use 2-3 nights per week initially
PM.whyItHelps: Dissolves pore buildup and prevents blackheads/breakouts.
PM.avoidNotes: Do not use on the same night as Retinol or Vitamin C.

PM.title: Azelaic Acid or Gentle BHA Serum
howToApply: Dispense pea-size amount onto clean dry skin
Smooth over areas with blemishes or redness
Let absorb for 2 minutes
PM.whyItHelps: Calms inflammation, reduces blemish redness, and evens skin texture.
PM.avoidNotes: Patch test new active ingredients first.

PM.title: Lightweight Barrier Repair Lotion
howToApply: Gently massage generous layer over face and neck
Pat remaining product into skin
PM.whyItHelps: Restores moisture barrier overnight while you sleep.

AM.title: Hydrating Milk / Non-Foaming Cleanser
howToApply: Apply to damp face and massage gently for 30 seconds
Rinse with lukewarm water or wipe off gently with wet cloth
Or rinse with plain lukewarm water if skin feels very tight
AM.whyItHelps: Cleanses without stripping essential natural oils or disrupting moisture barrier.

AM.title: Rich Hydrating Essence / Milky Toner
howToApply: Pat 4-5 drops onto face while skin is still slightly damp
Layer 2 times if skin feels extra dehydrated
AM.whyItHelps: Provides deep hydration layer and instantly soothes tightness.

AM.title: Hyaluronic Acid & Polyglutamic Serum
howToApply: Apply 3-4 drops onto damp skin
Press gently into skin until absorbed
AM.whyItHelps: Attracts and locks in moisture deep within skin layers.
AM.avoidNotes: Always apply on damp skin to avoid drawing moisture out.

AM.title: Nourishing Ceramide Cream
howToApply: Take almond-sized amount and warm between palms
Press into face and neck with gentle upward motions
AM.whyItHelps: Seals in hydration and repairs dry flaky barrier.
AM.avoidNotes: Ensure even coverage over dry cheek patches.

AM.title: Moisturizing Cream Sunscreen SPF 50
howToApply: Apply 2 finger lengths generously over face and neck
Allow 15 minutes before stepping out
AM.whyItHelps: Sun protection with added moisturizing emollients for dewy comfort.

PM.title: Nourishing Cleansing Balm / Oil Cleanse
howToApply: Massage balm on dry skin for 60 seconds to melt makeup/sunscreen
Add warm water to emulsify into milky texture
Rinse thoroughly with lukewarm water
PM.whyItHelps: Dissolves impurities while leaving skin soft and supple.
PM.avoidNotes: Avoid hot water which dries out skin further.

PM.title: Milky Hydrating Toner
howToApply: Press 3-4 drops gently into face and neck
PM.whyItHelps: Preps skin to absorb night treatment creams.
PM.avoidNotes: Avoid harsh acid toners unless prescribed.

PM.title: Barrier Strengthening Repair Serum
howToApply: Apply 3 drops across cheeks, forehead, and neck
Massage gently in upward strokes
PM.whyItHelps: Rebuilds lipid matrix and smooths rough texture overnight.
PM.avoidNotes: Introduce new actives one at a time.

PM.title: Deep Recovery Night Balm / Cream
howToApply: Apply generous layer as the final step of PM routine
Gently press into skin for maximum seal
PM.whyItHelps: Locks in moisture overnight and prevents transepidermal water loss.

AM.title: Gentle Balancing Gel Cleanser
howToApply: Lather pea-size amount with water
Massage T-zone first, then sweep lightly over dry cheeks
Rinse thoroughly with lukewarm water
AM.whyItHelps: Cleanses oilier T-zone without stripping dry cheek areas.

AM.title: Hydrating Balancing Essence
howToApply: Press into entire face with clean hands
AM.whyItHelps: Balances moisture levels between dry and oily zones.

AM.title: Niacinamide + Hyaluronic Acid Serum
howToApply: Apply 3 drops evenly over face
AM.whyItHelps: Controls T-zone shine while hydrating dry cheek areas.

AM.title: Lightweight Gel-Cream Moisturizer
howToApply: Apply thin layer on T-zone and slightly richer layer on cheeks
AM.whyItHelps: Customized moisture level for multi-zone skin needs.
AM.avoidNotes: Avoid heavy waxes on forehead and nose.

AM.title: Lightweight Fluid Sunscreen SPF 50
howToApply: Apply 2 finger lengths evenly over face and neck
AM.whyItHelps: Protects against UV damage without heavy residue.

PM.title: Gentle Double Cleanse
PM.texture: Micellar / oil followed by balancing gel
howToApply: Use micellar water on eyes and face first
Follow with gentle gel cleanser for 60 seconds
PM.whyItHelps: Completely removes daytime grime and sunscreen.

PM.title: Targeted BHA Toner (T-Zone 2-3x/week)
howToApply: Apply with cotton pad specifically on T-zone (nose, forehead, chin)
Avoid dry outer cheeks

PM.title: Centella & Barrier Repair Serum
howToApply: Apply 3 drops all over face and neck
PM.whyItHelps: Calms skin and promotes overnight cell renewal.

PM.title: Balancing Night Cream
howToApply: Massage into face and neck as final PM step

AM.title: pH-Balanced Hydrating Cleanser
howToApply: Massage over wet skin for 30 seconds
Rinse with lukewarm water
AM.whyItHelps: Maintains healthy natural barrier balance.

AM.title: Antioxidant Refreshing Toner
howToApply: Pat gently into face and neck
AM.whyItHelps: Hydrates and boosts skin freshness.

AM.title: Vitamin C Antioxidant Serum
howToApply: Apply 3-4 drops every morning on clean dry skin
AM.whyItHelps: Brightens tone and neutralizes free radicals from pollution.
AM.avoidNotes: Store in cool dark place to prevent oxidation.

AM.title: Daily Hydrating Cream
howToApply: Smooth evenly over face and neck
AM.whyItHelps: Sustains smooth texture and elasticity.

AM.title: Broad Spectrum Invisible Sunscreen SPF 50
howToApply: Apply 2 finger lengths 15 minutes before stepping outside
AM.whyItHelps: Essential protection against sun spots and aging.

PM.title: Gentle Cleanser
howToApply: Massage for 60 seconds with lukewarm water
Pat dry

PM.title: Hydrating Toner
howToApply: Press into skin

PM.title: Peptide / Niacinamide Renewal Serum
howToApply: Apply 3-4 drops before bedtime
PM.whyItHelps: Supports cellular repair and collagen formation.

PM.title: Nourishing Night Moisturizer
howToApply: Smooth over face and neck as final PM step
PM.whyItHelps: Locks in hydration through the night.

Oily: Patch test new active ingredients for 24-48 hours
Introduce 1 new active product every 2 weeks
Dry: Lactic Acid Gentle AHA Exfoliator 1x / week
Patch test new products on inner arm first
Always apply hydrating serums onto damp skin
Combination: Gentle AHA/BHA Exfoliant 1-2x / week on T-zone
Multi-masking: Clay mask on T-zone, hydrating mask on cheeks
Patch test new actives for 24-48 hours
Introduce 1 new active product every 2 weeks
Normal: Gentle Exfoliating Scrub or AHA Gel 1x / week
Always wear SPF even on cloudy days
